source_name: Portál gov.cz – service pages for NEN, Registr smluv, VVZ, ISoSS
why_relevant: Canonical service catalogue that resolves the current official URL, administrator and legal basis of each register in this cell — the safest way to detect when a register is moved or re-hosted (e.g. Registr smluv moving from MV to DIA), which otherwise looks like a dead link.

source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (data.gov.cz)
why_relevant: National open-data catalogue — the systematic way to discover further CZ registers and datasets relevant to corporate/organisational change (ARES, registers, statistical registers) that this cell has not yet enumerated, including datasets published by ČSÚ, MF and MSp.

source_name: LMC / Teamio white-label career-site pattern (*.jobs.cz)
why_relevant: POINTER: nearly every large CZ bank runs its career site as a branded subdomain of jobs.cz (kb., csob., rb., unicreditbank., moneta.). Enumerating <bankname>.jobs.cz is a reliable discovery heuristic for any CZ employer's official vacancy feed, including banks not yet in scope.

source_name: Veřejný rejstřík / spolkový rejstřík (justice.cz) — registrations of ZO OS union organisations at banks
why_relevant: Each basic union organisation (ZO OS pracovníků peněžnictví a pojišťovnictví <bank name>) is a registered legal entity with its own IČO, seat and statutory representatives. Registrations, address changes and dissolutions are an indirect but hard signal of union presence, mergers of bank entities, and site/branch consolidation. Mirrors (podnikatel.cz, rejstrik.penize.cz, kurzy.cz, finmag.cz) are easier to search by name.

entity_name: ČBA event/conference and education programme pages
source_name: Česká bankovní asociace — seznam členů (member list)
why_relevant: ČBA full membership covers ~34-37 banks and building societies representing >99% of the Czech banking sector; the member list is the canonical actor directory a scout should watch for jobs/leadership monitoring, and additions/exits themselves signal market entries and exits.

entity_name: ČBA event/conference and education programme pages
source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) — Komise a pracovní skupiny
why_relevant: ČBA committees and working groups are staffed by delegated specialists and chaired by senior managers of member banks; the roster is effectively a map of who owns payments, cards, compliance, digitalisation and HR agendas inside each Czech bank, and changes to it signal internal reorganisation and leadership moves.

entity_name: Česká fintech asociace / Czech Fintech Association
source_name: Česká fintech asociace / Czech Fintech Association (ČEFTAS) — members
why_relevant: Reported 50-80+ members spanning payment institutions, investment platforms, crypto/digital-asset firms, banks and investors (AKCENTA, GoPay, Twisto, ComGate, Adyen, Home Credit, Centrální depozitář cenných papírů, Banking Circle among names in press). Best single directory of non-bank payments actors in CZ; chairman reported as Miroslav Lukeš with Ondřej Machač as executive manager.

entity_name: Česká fintech asociace / Czech Fintech Association
source_name: Czech Fintech Association (czechfintech.cz)
why_relevant: Industry body whose member list enumerates CZ PSPs/BNPL/payment firms and whose board/working-group composition reveals who currently leads them.

entity_name: Česká fintech asociace / Czech Fintech Association
source_name: Czech Fintech Association (ČeFiA)
why_relevant: Member/actor map for the CZ fintech and payments scene; membership and board listings give the roster of companies and named individuals whose LinkedIn/X accounts should be enrolled in this cell's follow list.

source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — Membership Directory (Corporate)
why_relevant: Corporate directory listing member companies with profile pages; a cross-sector actor list that includes banks, payment firms and their vendors, useful for building the watch-list beyond pure financial associations.

source_name: Atmoskop employer-entity ID pattern (pointer to full CZ bank/fintech roster)
why_relevant: Each employer has a stable numeric ID + slug (e.g. 2946946-ceska-sporitelna-a-s, 2992632-...-penzijni-spolecnost). Enumerating IDs for every bank, its subsidiaries, payment institutions and their SSC entities builds the actor map for the whole A5 workstream.

entity_name: Odborový svaz pracovníků peněžnictví a pojišťovnictví
source_name: OSPPP — page listing basic union organisations by employer (odborové organizace)
why_relevant: Actor map: enumerates which Czech banks/insurers actually have a ZO (union presence) and gives contact points. This is the seed list for monitoring firm-level union communications and for knowing where a collective-redundancy consultation is legally required to happen.

source_name: ČLFA — seznam členských společností (39 members)
why_relevant: Directory of ~39 leasing / consumer-credit / non-bank finance companies operating in CZ — the actor set adjacent to banking that also hires payments, risk and collections staff. A third-party mirror on Finance.cz makes the list easy to snapshot.

source_name: 10times – Prague banking/payments event listings
why_relevant: International event aggregator with per-event pages, edition histories and organiser links for Prague finance/retail events. Useful for discovering editions and dates in a structured, machine-readable way; not a source of speaker titles itself.

source_name: archiv.hn.cz / ihned.cz tag archive (e.g. tag 'rezignace')
why_relevant: Long-run HN archive indexed by topic tags such as 'rezignace' — the single richest back-catalogue for reconstructing Czech banking leadership history.

source_name: Asociace pro kapitálový trh ČR (AKAT) — vedení a členové
why_relevant: Reported 100+ members (domestic investment companies, foreign fund managers, service providers) and elected leadership (chair reported as Jaromír Sladkovský as of June 2026; executive-director role reported variously as Jana Michalíková / historically Jana Brodani — must be re-verified). Both the directory and the elections are people-intelligence for asset-management arms of banks.

source_name: Blue Events – conference portfolio index
why_relevant: Organiser index covering Retail Summit, New Retail Summit (SK) and adjacent B2B conferences. A single pointer that enumerates which senior-audience events exist each year and where their speaker pages live, including cross-border CZ/SK editions.

source_name: CIO Business World / cio.cz — Případová studie (annual CZ IT case-study competition)
why_relevant: CIO CZ runs an annual 'Případová studie' feature/competition in which integrators submit named customer projects, including bank deployments. It aggregates vendor-authored case studies across many suppliers in one place — an efficient discovery surface for otherwise scattered bank programme disclosures.

source_name: E-ZAK Ministerstvo financí ČR (legacy buyer profile archive)
why_relevant: MF's pre-1.7.2018 buyer profile, still completing procurements started there. Historical baseline for who ran which payment/banking procurement before the NEN migration — useful for tracing career paths of named project owners over a decade.

source_name: Finastra — Find A Partner directory
why_relevant: Vendor partner directory is a classic pointer source: it enumerates the implementation firms operating in/serving the CZ market, several of which are otherwise invisible. Snowball each listed partner into its own customer references and hiring.

entity_name: Fondinfo.cz / opojisteni.cz / finance.cz association aggregator directories
source_name: Fondinfo.cz / opojisteni.cz / finance.cz association aggregator directories
why_relevant: Czech financial portals maintain curated lists of professional associations and their members; they are easier to scrape than some association sites and act as a fallback mirror when a primary site is JS-rendered or unreachable.

source_name: HRforum.cz — People Management Forum / Asociace personalistů ČR
why_relevant: The largest CZ HR association (founded 1993), publishes HR Forum magazine 6x/year and runs Fórum zaměstnanosti and HR Gala events whose programmes and press releases name which sectors (incl. banking) are debating hiring strategy. Conference speaker lists are a cheap map of bank HR directors.

source_name: Invest in Ostrava — Business Service Centres directory
why_relevant: City investment agency maintains a roster of the ~49 business-service centres in Ostrava with their focus areas (financial/accounting, IT, customer support) — an actor map for which financial-sector back-offices sit in the region, and thus which employers to monitor on review sites.

source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (portal-vz.cz) – MMR methodology & NIPEZ hub
why_relevant: Ministry for Regional Development's methodological hub for NIPEZ/NEN/VVZ. Explains which systems are mandatory for whom and where each authority's buyer profile lives — the map you need before scraping, and it announces structural changes to the procurement systems themselves.

source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty ČR (SBK) — činnost a členové
why_relevant: The closest Czech equivalent of a payments association: an interest grouping of banks and card-industry organisations (reported ~18 regular members plus ~23 observers) coordinating card/payment development. Its member+observer list is a directory of acquirers, processors, terminal and ATM players — exactly the actor set for payments hiring and org-change monitoring.

source_name: Svaz průmyslu a dopravy ČR (SP ČR) — odvětvové svazy / členská základna
why_relevant: The confederation's sectoral-association registry is a pointer-of-pointers: it lists ČBA, Česká fintech asociace and peer bodies with contact and profile pages, letting a scout enumerate financial-sector associations exhaustively rather than guessing names.

source_name: Workello guide: job boards in the Czech Republic
why_relevant: POINTER: recruiter-facing inventory of CZ job boards; a cheap way to enumerate boards beyond the obvious five and to understand each board's audience segment.

source_name: Česká kryptoměnová asociace (ČKMA)
why_relevant: Self-organising body for the Czech crypto/digital-asset industry (chair reported as František Vinopal; founding members include Confirmo/Coinmate, General Bytes, Simple Coin, Bitcomp). As MiCA-era crypto firms professionalise and hire compliance and payments staff, this is the directory of that actor set.
